scripts.types: wrangler types --config wrangler.jsonc --env-interface ReaderEnv .generated/reader-env.d.ts && wrangler types --config wrangler.publisher.jsonc --env-interface PublisherEnv .generated/publisher-env.d.ts
scripts.check: npm run schema && npm run types && tsc --noEmit && node --check public/app.js
scripts.dry-run: npm run schema && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/reader --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/publisher --config wrangler.publisher.jsonc
